text:
maria (Design): heads-up: I'm iterating on a compact rail where items are grouped into 'Collections' instead of folders. Question: when someone navigates via a permalink, should the rail highlight the item and leave collections collapsed, or auto-expand the containing collection?

tom (Frontend): prefer auto-expand so the item is visible. Otherwise users get a page with no context and have to hunt. Auto-expand should be non-destructive (no history entry).

kevin (PM): +1 on expand for discoverability. We should avoid query params like `?open=collections/a` unless necessary. Keep permalinks human-friendly: `/console/models/bert-42` rather than `#/models/bert-42?open=1`.

anya (A11y): Important: when we auto-expand we must move keyboard focus to the item and emit an aria-live update: "Opened collection X. Focus moved to item Y." Otherwise screen reader users can be left wandering.

maria (Design): Good call. Also thinking about breadcrumb text: do we show collection name in breadcrumb or the curated taxonomy name? Example: Collection= "Training Models", taxonomy= "Models". Breadcrumbs should reflect taxonomy (Models > BERT-42) not ephemeral collection names.

ben (Infra): Routing note: overlays (e.g., edit flyouts) should be addressable as path segments, not fragments. I.e., `/models/bert-42/edit` rather than `#edit`. That makes server logs and links cleaner.

kevin (PM): Agreed. That also helps support: we can email a link that opens the edit view directly. But make sure we don't break back button expectations. If a user closes the flyout, should back go back to previous page or keep them on same route?

tom (Frontend): Implementation plan: deep navigation -> expand minimal collections (no animation), call `history.replaceState` to avoid adding expansion states, then `focus()` the target element. For overlays, pushing a new history state when opening makes sense so back closes overlay.

anya (A11y): Also add `role="region" aria-label="Sidebar"` and announce changes with polite `aria-live` for expansion events. For focus landing in content area, ensure `tabindex="-1"` on the main heading so `element.focus()` lands correctly.

maria (Design): Copy nit: menu selection aria text should be the visible label, not the internal id. So e.g., announce "BERT 42, selected" not "model_bert_42_selected".

ben (Infra): Edge case: permalinks to deleted or moved items. Backend should return a 302-ish fallback path (e.g., `/models`) and the UI should show a toast "Item not found, showing Models list". We'll surface the original permalink in the toast as a help link.

kevin (PM): Nice. Also add telemetry: record whether permalink resolved -> expanded collection or fallback. Helps product understand breakage.

maria (Design): UX question: keyboard users navigating the rail with arrow keys — if they press Enter on a collection header should it navigate to a collection landing page or just toggle? We had mixed feedback in research.

tom (Frontend): Conventional pattern: Space toggles collapse, Enter navigates. That keeps toggling separate from activation. Can implement both but map Enter -> navigate to collection overview, Space -> toggle. Document it.

anya (A11y): Document keyboard mapping in the accessibility guide. Also ensure screen reader users have an instruction at the top of the rail the first time they interact: "Use arrow keys to navigate, Space to expand, Enter to open."

maria (Design): ok actionable list I'm taking away: 1) permalinks open and auto-expand containing collection (instant, no animation); 2) don't encode expanded state in URLs; 3) overlays are path-segment routable; 4) use replaceState for auto-expands, pushState for user toggles/overlays; 5) focus and aria-live announcements for a11y; 6) fallback flow for missing items with a toast.

deploy-bot: Reminder: UI deploy window tonight 23:30 UTC. Please avoid schema changes to routing endpoints during the window.

kevin (PM): I'll add these decisions to the nav RFC and link to the a11y checklist. Any objections?

maria (Design): none from me. Will drop a quick prototype GIF later. :sparkles:
